file_roles.evidence: The setExhaust / setInExhaustIsMaster block moves from clientCommand (using request.getCommandName() != 'isMaster') into runCommand, which uses the command found in the registry: command->getName() != 'isMaster'.

rationale: On mongos the exhaust flag used the raw request command name, so aliases of isMaster were mis-tracked. The diff switches to the registry-resolved name in the same file.
